configurePresets.name: native
configurePresets.description: 32-bit native Linux build (needs libsdl2-dev:i386). BUILD_STATIC links every package into one Game binary; appGetDllHandle resolves through the UNREAL_STATIC registry. Renderers: XOpenGLDrv and OpenGLDrv/UTGLR (system GL), SoftDrv, NullDrv. The renderer forks are fetched by branch; point FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_XOPENGLDRV / FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_UTGLR / GL4ES_SOURCE_DIR at a local clone to build an unpushed change. Builds in build-native/.

configurePresets.name: wasm
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build: -O2 with DWARF and assertions, the everyday dev build (named stacks, readable errors, playable speed). Needs EMSDK in the environment (source /home/ion/WorkUnreal/env.sh). Builds in build-wasm/.

configurePresets.name: wasm-debug
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build at -O0: nothing inlined, every local live. For when the optimiser is the suspect (a bug that shows at one -O level and not another is almost always undefined behaviour). Builds in build-wasm-debug/.

configurePresets.name: wasm-perf
configurePresets.description: Emscripten shipping build: compiled at -O2, linked at -O3 -g0 without assertions, plus a side symbol map. The build the frontend publishes. Builds in build-wasm-perf/.

configurePresets.name: windows
configurePresets.description: 32-bit Windows build, cross-compiled from Linux with the toolchain file (i686-w64-mingw32 and a fetched SDL2); the same preset works from an MSYS2 MINGW32 prompt. BUILD_STATIC links every package into the exe. Renderers: UTGLR (OpenGLDrv) and XOpenGLDrv through the system opengl32, SoftDrv, NullDrv. Audio: NOpenALDrv with OpenAL Soft's OpenAL32.dll copied beside the exe. Builds in build-windows/.
